name: Meshy
summary: AI 3D model generator that turns text prompts and images into game-ready, printable 3D assets.
description: 3D content generation platform: text prompts or reference images become textured 3D models in minutes, with PBR texturing, auto-rigging and 600+ animation presets. Assets target games (Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot), 3D printing (watertight, multi-color, slicer-ready) and VR/AR, and export as FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND, 3MF or DXF. Free tools include a 3D file converter and viewer; a developer API and editor plugins are available.
contains: Text to 3D and Image to 3D with Meshy 7
AI texturing with PBR maps and 4K HD textures
auto-rigging with 600+ motion presets for bipeds and quadrupeds
exports FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND, 3MF, DXF
printable watertight models with slicer and engine plugins
free plan with 100 credits/month; free-plan assets licensed CC BY 4.0
